summary: $35 confirmed on Campspot (June 2027: $38.05 all-in = $35 + the park's $2 booking fee + 3% processing). 50A/water, Campspot, phone 765-675-1177 confirmed. Site count and dump/showers confirmed on the operator's page. County-run: local stands.
flags: RUNNER: the operator's home page says 'Tipton County Government has invested heavily in making our fairgrounds...' and credits 'the Tipton County Facility Manager'. Site brands it Tipton County Event Center. local stands; I read county-run, inferred from those lines rather than a stated legal operator. Campspot sells ordinary nights to the public, no event needed.

SEWER LEAD: operator says 'electrical hookups and septic cleanout' on nearly all 100 sites; Campspot's types list water and electric without sewer. Left hookups.sewer unset; a septic cleanout at the site may be a real sewer connection, so a call would settle it (765.675.1177, office Mon-Fri 8-5).
SEASON: stored year_round rests on old note prose; neither page says it and Campspot prices January as well as June. Left alone.

PIN: 40.26907,-86.04180 is on the event center buildings (also Campspot's point). The site areas are named North, Center, South and West Lots spread across ~400 m of fairgrounds, but no pads are visible on imagery and I can't locate the camp rows, so no corrected pin. A creek or drainage ditch north of the grounds and no water at the sites: not waterfront stands.
